plan.notes:
Per the 2026-2027 Texas A&M University undergraduate catalog: Bioenvironmental Sciences (BS). Prerequisites are not listed in the catalog's plan of study grid; consult course descriptions.
Catalog footnotes:
[grid1 fn1] Graduation requirements include a requirement for 3 hours of International and Cultural Diversity courses and 3 hours of Cultural Discourse courses. A course satisfying a Core category, a college/department requirement or a free elective can be used to satisfy this requirement. Select in consultation with an academic advisor.
[grid1 fn2] Select 18 hours from BESC 203 , BESC 204 , BESC 311 , BESC 314 , BESC 320 , BESC 357 , BESC 367 , BESC 401 , BESC 402 , BESC 403 , BESC 411 , BESC 421 , BESC 431 , BESC 489 , SCSC 405 . Other courses may be approved by advisor.
